$doc: EMULATOR-ONLY config for testing RUN's crowd backend (WP-B). firestore.test.rules is a test-time COPY of the Foresight repo's single ruleset (../marketing/web/firestore.rules - firebase-tools cannot reference rules outside the project dir); refresh it with `cp ../../marketing/web/firestore.rules firebase/firestore.test.rules` before an emulator run. Functions point at the canonical functions-run source. Never used for a deploy: live deploys run from the Foresight repo with scoped --only flags (owner-gated).
